scope: Strict GDScript compilation, the headless source gate (Godot cases plus Python data contracts), rendered gallery capture in both skins, an exported native boot, and a seeded exported-native playthrough. The encrypted pack export and the owner play/listening pass remain open.

steps.note: Every one of the 49 GDScript warning categories is treated as an error.
tests/run_tests.py full run at this tree: strict compile, the Godot cases, every Python data contract, and a complete playthrough to rank 1.
tests/capture_gallery.gd with GAME_GALLERY_THEME=dark; zero layout warnings.
tests/capture_gallery.gd with GAME_GALLERY_THEME=light; zero layout warnings.
Clean --quit exit on the public build. A SIGTERM during a run produces Godot shutdown noise on both the old and the new binary, so the clean-exit run is the reference.
Seeded cycle on the QA export (qa_verifier feature plus GAME_QA=1), driven entirely through real buttons. The QA binary is never published as a release asset.
scripts/ReleaseVerification.gd is packed into the QA build and physically absent from the public build, which is the security boundary the contract enforces.

steps.reason: The private GODOT_SCRIPT_ENCRYPTION_KEY and a matching custom Windows release template are unavailable on this host. The public 2.1.1 pack is deliberately non-encrypted (commit b0e7d59).
A human pass over the shipped build, including listening to the score, is not something this host can assert.
